propose_timeout_ms: the network applier and the CometBFT propose-delay

# time_s: # controller all anchor on the same --start-unix-ms
# phase at warmUpTime + atTime. ScheduledTimeoutModel shifts the whole schedule
# so its first row lands at elapsed 0
# a switch written at T fires at warmUpTime + T. Writing the atTime value here
# therefore lands the switch exactly on the phase boundary.
#   p0 @0    no fault                        150  all rungs tie (+0.333)
#   p1 @300  proposalDelay 10s               150  lowest escape wins (+0.228 vs 450 -0.033)
#   p3 @900  net +50ms + proposalDelay 10s   450  lowest value that clears the links (-0.349)
#   p5 @1500 no fault                        150  all rungs tie
